title: Retro Snake
description: Classic slither arcade. Collect red apples and golden bonuses without hitting the walls or your own tail.

title: 2048 Puzzle
description: Join matching numbers and slide tiles across the board until you reach the legendary 2048 tile.

title: Tetro Blocks
description: Arrange falling geometric tetromino shapes, rotate blocks, and clear rows before the stack reaches the top.

title: Brick Breaker
description: Deflect the high-speed ball with your paddle to smash through multi-colored brick formations.

title: Sky Hopper
description: Tap or press space to flap your wings and navigate through tricky pipe obstacles.

title: Retro Pong
description: The grandfather of video games. Play paddle tennis against an adaptable AI bot.

title: Space Defense
description: Pilot your starship and fire laser blasters at descending waves of alien invaders.

title: Doodle Jump
description: Bounce continuously up bouncy green platforms, collecting springs and avoiding falls.
